inert_data_model: Only plain echo/sole git-log grep data and exact frozen-native help vectors bypass continuation classification after generic guards. The common shell subset permits balanced complete double quotes for literal operators. Single quotes never protect evaluation/control syntax; expansion, unquoted grouping, quote/escape fragments and unknown explicit shells remain UNKNOWN. The strict native selector reader also refuses single quotes and unquoted backslashes.
shell_family_model: S1: data/help and native selector qualification share one bounded shell grammar. Static spelling fragments are detected conservatively and never supply target proof. The table crosses shell metadata and both native tool envelopes; source=true rows also run both source-hook processes.
